content: Maine zindagi se pucha: Itni mushkil kyu ho? Zindagi boli: Tu har cheez Google pe dhoondhta hai, main pariksha hoon, FAQ nahi!
Paisa aur pyaar me bas itna farak hai: Paisa kam ho toh neend udti hai, pyaar kam ho toh WhatsApp status shuru ho jaate hain.
Kisi aur se dhoka khane se behtar hai mere saath chalo, momos aur golgappe khayenge.
Dil ko baaton me uljha leta hoon, main bina babu ke puchhe bhi teen time pet bhar ke khana kha leta hoon.
Desi gharelu niyam: Fridge se thanda paani ki botal nikaal kar peene ke baad agar wapas nahi bhari, toh ghar se bedakhal ho sakte ho.
Monday se hume aisi allergy hai jiska koi ilaaj duniya ke kisi medical science ke paas nahi hai.
Fire ko aag kehte hain, garden ko baagh kehte hain, aur exam ke waqt jo bilkul freeze ho jaye use student ka dimaag kehte hain.
Diet kal se pakka shuru hogi, par problem ye hai ki calendar me kal ka din kabhi aata hi nahi.
Zindagi 2G speed par chal rahi hai aur tension ka data pack 5G unlimited hai.
Main late nahi aata, bas meri entry thodi dramatic aur stylish hoti hai.

Patni (gusse me): Main itni der se puch rahi hoon ki chai me cheeni kitni daalu, par tum jawab hi nahi de rahe! \n Pati (darte hue): Jaanu, jitni meethi tum ho, utni hi daal do. \n Patni: Achha theek hai... feeki hi bana deti hoon!
Patni: Suno, mere muh me machhar chala gaya, ab kya karu? \n Pati: Pagli, All Out pee le, 6 second me kaam shuru!
Patni: Chal toh rahe ho mere maayke, par waha ladna mat, wo mere papa ka ghar hai. \n Pati: Toh mere baap ka ghar kya Kurukshetra hai, jo tu yaha roz Mahabharat karti hai!

Pati ko tiffin dete hue Patni ne kaha: Shaam ko jaldi ghar aa jaana. \n Pati (romantic hote hue): Meri yaad aa rahi hai kya? \n Patni: Zyada hero banne ki zaroorat nahi hai, aaj shaam ko bartan dhone ki baari tumhari hai, isliye yaad dila rahi hoon!

Patni: Shaadi ke samay saat phere lete waqt tumne vachan diya tha ki meri izzat karoge aur meri har baat maanoge! \n Pati: Toh kya itne saalon se main teri baat nahi maan raha? Maine kabhi kaha ki tu meri baat maan!
Patni: Suno ji, agar mere peeche sher pad jaye toh tum kya karoge? \n Pati: Main kya karunga, sher ne galti ki hai toh sher hi apna bachav karega!

Patni: Agar main 4-5 din ghar pe na dikhu toh kaisa lagega? 
 Pati: Bohot achha lagega! 
 Somwar gaya, Mangalwar gaya, Budhwar gaya, Guruwar gaya... 
 Shukrawar ko jab aankh ki soojan thodi kam hui, tab jaakar patni dikhayi di!

Patni: Kal jo bhikhari khana maangne aaya tha, bohot badtameez nikla! \n Pati: Kyu, kya kiya usne? \n Patni: Kal maine use khana khilaya tha, aur aaj subah aakar mujhe 'Khana Pakana Sikhein' ki kitaab de gaya!

Girlfriend: Agar main mar jaau toh tum kya karoge? 
 Boyfriend: Main bhi mar jaaunga. 
 Girlfriend: Aww, itna pyaar karte ho mujhse? 
 Boyfriend: Pyaar nahi pagli, tere chakkar me itni udhaari ho gayi hai ki ab akele jeena mushkil hai!

Girlfriend: Kya tum mere liye sher ko maar kar la sakte ho? 
 Boyfriend: Pagal ho gayi ho kya, sher se ladna aasan hai kya? Kuch aur batao, main tumhare liye kuch bhi kar sakta hoon. 
 Girlfriend: Achha theek hai, kya main tumhara WhatsApp aur Instagram check kar sakti hoon? 
 Boyfriend: Kahan hai wo sher jiske baare mein tum baat kar rahi thi?

Boyfriend: Kahan thi tum, main kal se tumhara phone laga raha hoon? 
 Girlfriend: Sorry baby, main friends ke saath shopping karne mall gayi thi. 
 Boyfriend: Kya-kya liya dikhao? 
 Girlfriend: Zyada kuch nahi, bas 2 bracelet, 1 rumaal aur 300 selfies!

Boyfriend: Tumhe jeevan mein sabse zyada kya chahiye? 
 Girlfriend: Paise. 
 Boyfriend: Achha, paison ko thodi der side mein rakh do, ab batao kya chahiye? 
 Girlfriend: Side mein rakhe hue paise!

Girlfriend: Tum mujhse kitna pyaar karte ho? 
 Boyfriend: Itna ki tumhare liye chaand-taare bhi tod laau. 
 Girlfriend: Sach me baby? 
 Boyfriend: Haan, lekin pehle 500 rupaye UPI kar do, bike me petrol dalwana hai!
Boyfriend: Yaar tumne mera dil tod kar chaknachoor kar diya. \n Girlfriend: Koi nahi babu, courier kar dena, main kabaadi wale ko bech dungi!
Girlfriend: Main gusse me bohot khatarnak lagti hoon na? \n Boyfriend: Haan, bilkul jale hue papad jaisi! \n (Tabhi se boyfriend hospital ke ICU ward ke bahar admit hai)

Teacher: Tum school der se kyu aaye? 
 Pappu: Sadak par lage sign board ke kaaran sir. 
 Teacher: Kaisa board? 
 Pappu: Jis par likha tha - 'Aage school hai, kripya dheere chalein'!

Teacher: Ek taraf paisa hai aur doosri taraf akal... batao Pappu tum kya chunoge? 
 Pappu: Paisa sir. 
 Teacher: Galat! Main hota toh akal chunta. 
 Pappu: Aapki baat bhi sahi hai sir, jiske paas jis cheez ki kami hoti hai wo wahi chunta hai!
Teacher: Bhais apni pooch kyu hilati hai? \n Student: Kyu ki sir pooch me itni taakat nahi hoti ki wo poori bhais ko hila sake!

Teacher: Zyada 3-5 mat karo, 9-2-11 ho jao, nahi toh 5-7 kheench kar dunga toh 6 ke 36 nazar aayenge aur 32 ke 32 daant bahar nikal aayenge. \n Student: Bas sir samajh gaya... Hindi-English hi theek hai, Maths ki bhasha toh bohot khaufnaak hai!

Teacher: Tumne zindagi me kabhi koi achha aur nek kaam kiya hai? \n Student: Haan sir, kal hi ek buzug dheere-dheere apne ghar jaa rahe the, maine unke peeche kutta dauda diya, wo do minute me ghar pahunch gaye!
Teacher: Agar koi school ke gate ke saamne laawaris bomb rakh jaye, toh tum kya karoge? \n Student: Ek-do ghante dekhenge sir, agar koi lene nahi aaya toh staff room me rakh denge!

Teacher: Bachho batao agar raat me sote waqt machhar kaate toh kya karna chahiye? \n Student: Chupchaap khuja kar so jaana chahiye sir, kyu ki aap Rajinikanth toh ho nahi ki machhar se sorry bulwa loge!

Teacher: Board par 55 likh kar dikhao. 
 (Pappu ne board par ek 5 likha aur sochne laga) 
 Teacher: Ruk kyu gaya, dusra 5 likh! 
 Pappu: Sir soch raha hoon dusra 5 pehle wale ke right side likhu ya left side!
Dost 1: Bhai, aaj college bunk karein? \n Dost 2: Haan bhai bilkul! Chal apna-apna phone switch off kar dete hain taaki gharwale ya dost dhoondh na sakein!

Hostel Student: Maine ghar par phone karke kitaabon ke liye 5000 rupaye mangwaye the... \n Dost: Phir kya hua? \n Hostel Student: Gharwalo ne agle hi din speed post se saari kitaabein khareed kar bhej di!

College canteen me padhai karte waqt dost ki kitaab par chai gir gayi. \n Doosra dost: Arre chinta mat kar bhai, chai toh kitaab me absorb ho gayi, kam se kam gyaan toh chai ke saath andar chala gaya!
Desi college rule: Ek student ki zindagi me bas do hi maksad hote hain - Pehla kisi tarah 4 saal me B.Tech poora karna, aur doosra degree milne ke baad kisi bhi rishtedaar ko B.Tech lene se rokna!
College Professor: Tumhari attendance itni kam kyu hai? \n Student: Sir campus ka Wi-Fi itna tez chalta hai ki hum hostel ke kamre me baith kar hi aapki location track kar lete hain!
Student: Sir, exam hall me invigilator humesha meri desk ke paas hi aakar kyu khade hote hain? \n Professor: Kyu ki beta, poori class me sabse shaqi aur masoom chehra tera hi lagta hai!
Dost 1: Hamari dosti itni pakki hai ki kabhi nahi toot sakti! \n Dost 2: Haan bhai bilkul nahi tootegi... jab tak tu apna pichhla 2000 rupaye udhar wapas nahi mangta!

Dost: Bhai meri ek help kar dega? 
 Doosra Dost: Haan bhai, bol na, tere liye toh jaan bhi hazir hai! 
 Dost: Bas 500 rupaye GPay kar de. 
 Doosra Dost: Bhai jaan maangta toh de deta, par paise maang kar tune dosti ko sasta kar diya!
Dost 1: Mera toh yahi maanna hai ki kisi se karz lena hi aadmi ki barbaadi ki wajah hai. \n Dost 2: Galat sochte ho bhai! Karz lena nahi, balki karz wapas chukana hi barbaadi ki asli wajah hai!
Friendship Day par sab status laga rahe hain 'Tu jaan hai meri', inhi dosto se agle din 500 rupaye maang lo toh agle chaar hafte tak 'Last seen yesterday' dikhayega!

Dost: Bhai tu itna khush kyu ghoom raha hai? 
 Doosra Dost: Arre mere roommate ne nayi sports bike li hai! 
 Dost: Toh isme tu kyu uchhal raha hai? 
 Doosra Dost: Kyu ki petrol wo dalwayega aur chalayenge dono bhai!
Desi dost ki sabse badi nishani: Jab tu sadak par phisalke girega, toh pehle 5 minute pet pakad kar hansega, group me photo bhejega, aur phir haath aage badha kar uthayega!
Mehmaan: Khana bohot lazeez aur swadist bana hai bhabhi ji! \n Chhote Bete ne turant kaha: Haan aunty, aaj mummy ne khud banaya hai, warna baaki din toh hum sab bhagwan bharose hi rehte hain!
Desi sanyukt parivaar me TV remote ka kanoon: Jo sadasya remote par haath rakh kar so gaya, remote usi ka adhikar samjha jayega chahe chhota bhai kitna bhi chillaye!
Rishtedaar: Beta, aage ka kya socha hai? \n Beta: Bas uncle, pehle aap apni chai khatam karke ghar niklein, phir aage ka shaanti se sochenge!
Parivaar ke WhatsApp group ka niyam: Papa subah 5 baje 50 logo ko 'Shubh Prabhat' ka phool bhejte hain, aur mummy din bhar recipe video dekh kar shaam ko wahi lauki bana kar parosti hain!

Papa: Beta, main market se 'Hair Oil' lene jaa raha hoon, agar mummy poochhe toh bata dena. 
 Beta: Theek hai papa ji. 
 (Thodi der baad mummy aayi) 
 Mummy: Beta, tere papa kahan gaye hain? 
 Beta: Mummy, papa gaye 'tel lene'!

Beta: Papa, aapne mummy me aisa kya dekha tha jo shaadi ke liye haan kar di? \n Papa: Uske gaal par ek chhota sa til tha beta. \n Beta: Kamaal hai papa! Ek chhotey se til ke liye aapne itni badi musibat mol le li!

Beta: Mummy, mere 500 rupaye kahan gaye jo table par rakhe the? 
 Mummy: Maine safe rakh liye hain. 
 Beta: Kyu mummy? 
 Mummy: Teri suraksha ke liye! 
 Beta: Kaisi suraksha? 
 Mummy: Taaki tu use faltu kharch karke barbaad na kare!

Papa: Beta, mummy kahan gayi hai? 
 Beta: Prakritik rachna chhed-chhad kendra! 
 Papa: Beta ye kaun sa naya kendra khul gaya shahar me? 
 Beta: Arre papa, Beauty Parlour!

Beta: Mummy sar dard ho raha hai... 
 Mummy: Aur chala mobile! 
 Beta: Mummy pet me marod ho rahi hai... 
 Mummy: Aur chala raat bhar mobile! 
 Beta: Mummy lagta hai bukhar hai... 
 Mummy: Sab is mobile ki den hai, ise aag me daal do!
Behen: Bhaiya, shaadi ke baad kya tum mujhe sach me yaad karoge? \n Bhai: Haan behen... bilkul yaad karunga, khaaskar tab jab bina kisi ladai ke TV ka remote seedhe mere haath me hoga!
Bhai: Meri nayi oversized t-shirt kisne pehni hai? \n Behen: Fashion world me ise sharing kehte hain bhaiya, zyada gussa mat karo!

Bhai: Tu itna ro kyu rahi hai? \n Behen: Bhaiya mere board exam me bohot kam number aaye hain, bas 91%! \n Bhai: Behen thoda raham kar, itne number me toh hamare jaise teen ladke araam se pass ho jaate!

Behen: Agar main achanak ek din gayab ho jau, toh kya tum mujhe dhoondhoge? 
 Bhai: Pehle tere kamre ki talashi lunga! 
 Behen: Aww, mujhe dhoondhne ke liye? 
 Bhai: Nahi, tere chhipaye hue chocolates aur snacks dhoondhne ke liye!
Behen: Mera phone charger kahan hai? \n Bhai: Wahi hai jahan tune rakha tha. \n Behen: Agar mujhe pata hota ki kahan rakha hai, toh main tujhse poochhti kyu?

Boss: Tumne is saal bohot lagan se kaam kiya hai, isliye main tumhe 50,000 rupaye ka bonus cheque de raha hoon! \n Employee: Thank you sir! \n Boss: Agar agle saal bhi aise hi kaam karoge, toh is cheque par sign bhi kar dunga!
HR: Tumhe promotion aur hike kyu chahiye? \n Employee: Kyunki sir office me doosron ka aadha kaam toh main hi karta hoon, aur apna poora kaam waise bhi bhagwan bharose rehta hai!
Corporate jeevan ka niyam: Somwar subah 9 baje laptop kholte hi screen par 'Welcome' likha aata hai, par andar ki aatma keh rahi hoti hai 'Bhaag jaa yahan se'!

Employee: Sir main 10 baje aata hoon aur 6 baje chala jaata hoon. \n Manager: Par company 24 ghante tumhari lagan chahti hai! \n Employee: Sir company ko boliye pehle battery backup lagwaye, main toh human body hoon!

Employee: Sir, mujhe 4 din ki chhutti chahiye. 
 Boss: Chhutti ek shart par milegi, ye batao ki Katappa ne Bahubali ko kyu maara tha? 
 Employee: Sir ho sakta hai ki Bahubali ne Katappa ki chhutti reject kar di ho! 
 Boss: Kitne din ki chhutti chahiye bolo?

Employee: Sir, meri patni chahti hai ki main uske saath 5 din ghoomne chalu, isliye chhutti chahiye thi. \n Boss: Bilkul nahi milegi! \n Employee: Thank you so much sir! Main jaanta tha ki musibat ke waqt aap hi mere kaam aayenge!
Employee: Sir, aaj aap par shirt bohot suit kar rahi hai! \n Boss: Chhutti nahi milegi! \n Employee: Sir, maine sirf shirt ki tareef ki thi, chehra toh abhi bhi bandar jaisa hi lag raha hai!
Boss: Tum office hamesha aadha ghanta late kyu aate ho? \n Employee: Sir aap hi toh kehte hain ki 'Office ko apna ghar hi samjho'... toh ghar se nikalne me thoda aalas toh aa hi jaata hai!
Doctor: Agar tum meri dawaai se theek ho gaye toh mujhe kya inaam doge? \n Mareez: Sahab main bohot gareeb aadmi hoon, qabr khodta hoon... aapki bilkul free me khod dunga! \n (Doctor behosh)
Mareez: Doctor sahab, mujhe toh khansi thi aur aapne mujhe loose motion ki dawa kyu de di? \n Doctor: Beta ab tu khansne se pehle 10 baar sochega!
Doctor: Dawa lene ke baad ab aapki tabiyat kaisi hai? \n Mareez: Doctor sahab, aapki fees ka bill dekhne ke baad toh aur zyada kharab ho gayi hai!
Doctor: Aapko sehatmand rehne ke liye roz subah 5 kilometer paidal chalna chahiye. \n Mareez: Doctor sahab, 5 kilometer chala toh jaunga, par wapas ghar kaun layega?
Mareez: Doctor sahab, meri aankhein bohot kamzor ho gayi hain. \n Doctor: Saamne wall par kya dikh raha hai? \n Mareez: Aapki fees 1000 rupaye likhi hai, aur wo ekdum HD clear dikh rahi hai!

Ghar ka nal theek karne ke baad plumber ne 800 rupaye maange. \n Engineer: Arre bhai, 1 ghante ki itni fees toh meri company bhi mujhe nahi deti! \n Plumber: Sir, jab main engineer tha, tab meri company bhi nahi deti thi!
Engineering student chhat par khada tha, tabhi pados ke uncle ne poochha: Toh beta, aage ka kya socha hai? \n Student: Bas uncle, tanki bharte hi motor band kar dunga!
Bhikari: Bhagwan ke naam par kuch de de babu... \n Student: Ye le meri degree rakh le! \n Bhikari: Bas kar bhai ab rulayega kya? Tu chahe toh meri engineering ki degree bhi le ja!
Engineering exam ka shashwat satya: Jo padha usme se aadha samajh nahi aaya, jo samajh aaya usme se aadha yaad nahi raha, aur jo yaad raha usme se ek bhi sawal paper me nahi aaya!

Client: Sab kuch local host par toh first class chal raha tha, production par aate hi server kyu fat gaya? \n Developer: Sir wo... code shuruat me thoda shy aur emotional hai, use production ka aggressive mahoul raas nahi aa raha!
Question: Software developers dark mode kyu pasand karte hain? \n Answer: Kyunki roshni dekh kar bugs (keede) aakar attract ho jaate hain!

Patni: Tum shaadi ke baad se bohot selfish ho gaye ho! \n Pati: Bhagwan ke liye batao toh hua kya hai? \n Patni: Jo tumhare laptop me folder hai, tum uska naam 'Our Documents' bhi toh rakh sakte the na, hamesha 'My Documents' kyu hota hai!

Programmer ka confidence level 4 stages me: 
 1. Main ye bug 2 minute me fix kar dunga. 
 2. Ye mujhse nahi hoga. 
 3. Shayad mujhe IT chhod kar kheti shuru kar deni chahiye. 
 4. Arre yaar, bas ek semi-colon missing tha!
QA Tester: Is app me 15 bugs hain! \n Developer: Wo bugs nahi hain, wo undocumented features hain jo user ke thrill ke liye design kiye gaye hain!
Insaan beemar hone par utni tezi se dawaai nahi dhoondhta, jitni tezi se phone ki battery 5% hone par charger dhoondhne lagta hai!

Customer Care: Ji kahiye kya madad kar sakta hoon? \n Mahila: Pichhle teen ghante se internet nahi chal raha hai, main kya karu? \n Customer Care: Behenji, tab tak thoda kitchen me jaakar ghar ka kaam hi nipta lijiye!
Yamraj: Beti kahan jaana pasand karogi, Swarg ya Narak? \n Ladki: Uncle bas dharti se mera smartphone aur fast charger manga dijiye, main dono jagah araam se adjust kar lungi! \n (Yamraj behosh)
Ghar ka kadwa sach: Wi-Fi ka asli control router ke password me nahi, mummy ke mood aur padhai ke score par depend karta hai!
Shyamu ne apni crush ka phone secretly check kiya toh apna saved contact name dekh kar dang reh gaya... Likh rakha tha: 'Free Recharge Wale Bhaiya'!
Photo me itne filters laga kar post kiya ki jab shaam ko ladke ne aaine me apna asli chehra dekha toh aaina bol pada: 'Bhai tu kaun hai, theek se pehchan me nahi aa raha!'

Doctor: Aapko itna high blood pressure aur stress kyu ho raha hai? \n Patient: Doctor sahab, reel upload kiye huye 3 ghante beet gaye hain aur abhi tak bas 14 likes aaye hain, wo bhi dosto se bheekh maang kar karwaye hain!
Patni: Maine naya Wi-Fi lagwaya hai, password guess karo! Hamari shaadi ki anniversary date daalo. \n Pati ne date daali toh wrong password aa gaya. \n Patni: Password hai - 'WrongPassword'!
Blue ticks se bachne ka vigyaan: Message padh kar reply na karna ek kala hai, par message padhne se pehle phone ko Flight Mode par daalna ek higher science hai!

Ladke ka WhatsApp Status: 'Feeling completely broken, lonely, and ignored by the universe...' \n Neeche 2 minute me dost ka reply: 'Bhai dukh apni jagah hai, pehle bata shaam ko kurkure momos khane chalega kya?'
Family WhatsApp group ka niyam: Subah 5:30 baje Chamakate suraj aur gungunate phoolon ke saath 10 MB ka 'Suprabhat' video aana anivarya hai, chahe phone ki memory full kyu na ho jaye!
Desi sabzi shopping ka ultimate niyam: 500 rupaye ki sabzi khareedne ke baad agar sabzi wale se muft me dhaniya aur do hari mirchi na li jaye, toh shopping safal nahi maani jaati!

Customer: Bhaiya ye branded kurti kitne ki hai? 
 Shopkeeper: 2500 rupaye ki ma'am. 
 Customer: 400 me doge kya? 
 Shopkeeper (hairaan): Madam, 400 me toh iska dupatta bhi nahi banta! 
 Customer: Theek hai, toh 400 me dupatta hi pack kar do!
Online shopping ka psychology: Cart me 3500 rupaye ke kapde add kiye, checkout par 49 rupaye ki delivery fee dekh kar dil toot gaya aur pura order hi cancel kar diya!

Monthly salary ka chaar-charni safar: 
 1st ko: Badshah Nawab. 
 10th ko: Aam Aadmi. 
 20th ko: Fakir Malang. 
 25th ke baad: 'Bhai bas 2 din me tere paise gpay karta hoon'!
Beta: Papa mujhe college trip ke liye 1000 rupaye chahiye the. \n Papa: 800? 600 ka kya karega? 400 bohot hote hain, ye le 200 aur 100 shaam ko wapas laana!
Mahine ke aakhri hafte me wallet khol kar dekha toh bas do cheezein mili: Ek purana passport size photo aur chaar failed transaction ke ATM receipts!
Middle class ghar ka toothpaste law: Jab tak tube par belan chala kar aur ant me use kainchi se kaat kar ungli se aakhri boond na nikaal li jaye, tab tak naya toothpaste packet kholna paap hai!
TV remote ka cell jab down hota hai, toh middle class ghar me naya cell nahi aata... pehle remote ko sofa par thappad maarte hain, cell ko gol ghumate hain aur agle 6 mahine wahi chalate hain!
Desi middle class kapde ka jeevan chakra: Pehle shaadi-party me, phir normal ghoomne me, phir ghar par daily wear, phir night dress, aur ant me kitchen ya bike ka pocha!

Desi mehmaannawazi ka niyam: Agar koi ghar par aaye aur puchhe 'Chai piyoge?' aur aap bol dein 'Nahi shukriya', toh wo phir bhi ek kadak cup bana kar saamne rakh denge aur bolenge: 'Thodi si pee lo, ab toh ban hi gayi hai'!
Indian parents ka special alarm clock: Subah 6:30 baje room me aakar ghadi dekh kar chillayenge: 'Utho jaldi! 8:30 baj gaye hain, poora din bistar me hi bitaoge kya?'

Desi technician principle: Duniya ka koi bhi electronic appliance ho - chahe TV, cooler ya remote - jab tak use upar se do thappad na padein, tab tak use pata hi nahi chalta ki use theek se chalna hai!
Shaadi ke buffet me ladke ne daba-daba kar 10 butter naan pel diye. Aadhi raat ko pet me aisi aag lagi ki bathroom me baith kar bol pada: 'Hey bhagwan, ya toh jaan nikaal le, ya naan nikaal le!'

Pandit ji ne kundali milayi toh 36 ke 36 gun match ho gaye! Phir bhi ladke ke baap ne shaadi se saaf inkaar kar diya. \n Ladki wale (hairaan hokar): Jab 36 gun mil rahe hain toh mana kyu kar rahe hain? \n Ladke ka baap: Hamara beta toh poora nalayak aur awara hai, ab kya bahu bhi bilkul aisi hi le aayein!

Pati aur patni mannat maangne wale kuye ke paas gaye. Pehle pati ne sikka daala, fir patni ne sikka daala toh uska pair phisla aur wo kuye me gir gayi! Pati ki aankho me aansu aa gaye aur hath jod kar bola: 'Hey bhagwan, itni fast delivery ki ummeed nahi thi!'
Dost: Bhai tu itne saalon se single kyu betha hai? \n Single Boy: Dekh bhai, main single apni marzi se nahi hoon, balki shehar ki saari ladkiyon ki aapsi sehmati se hoon!
14th February ko couples ka schedule: Rose, Teddy, Candle light dinner aur 10,000 ka bill. \n Singles ka schedule: Subah 11 baje uthna, pet bhar rajma-chawal pelna aur blanket me ghus kar so jaana!
Single rehne ka sabse sukoon bhara faayda: Raat ko 11 baje phone ka charger dhoondhne ke alawa zindagi me koi doosra tension hi nahi hota!

Boyfriend: Jaan, main sach me tumhare bina ek pal bhi nahi jee sakta! \n Girlfriend: Achha ji? Toh abhi 5 minute saans rok kar dikhao! \n Boyfriend: Pagli, main romantic talk kar raha tha, tu toh seedha biological attack par utar aayi!

First date par restaurant me: 
 Boyfriend: Tum apne liye kya order karogi? 
 Girlfriend: Main toh bas green tea aur cucumber salad leti hoon... 
 Shaadi ke 6 mahine baad: 'Suno, aate waqt 2 plate chhole kulche aur 1 kilo gulab jamun lete aana, bhookh lag rahi hai!'
Crush ne bas hallway me chalte huye ek second ke liye dekh kar halki si smile kya di... ladke ne dimaag me shaadi ka venue, 2 bachho ke naam aur future home loan tak plan kar liya!
Biryani lovers ka dard: Dum Biryani khate waqt daant ke neeche elaichi ka aana bilkul waisa hi hai, jaise climax romantic scene ke beech me YouTube par 20 second ka non-skippable ad aa jaye!
Desi dieting struggle: Subah se oats aur boiled egg khaye, shaam ko gali ke mod par golgappe wale ka thela dekh kar aatma ne bagawat kar di aur 4 plate teekhe paani-puri pel diye!

Doctor: Health theek rakhni hai toh din bhar me bas ek chhota cup chai piya karo. \n Patient: Theek hai doctor sahab, maine market se 1 litre capacity wala beer mug khareed liya hai, ab usi me chai pita hoon!
1st January ko high motivation ke sath 1 saal ki gym membership li. 2nd January ko pure shareer me itna khatarnak dard hua ki toothpaste ka dhakkan kholne ke liye bhi roommate ki madad leni padi!
Trainer: Weight loss karna hai toh roz 5 km running ke baad sugar-free green tea piyo. \n Client: Sir green tea ke saath do garam samose aur meethi chutney chalegi kya?
Modern gym workout schedule: 5 minute cardio, 5 minute dumbbell, aur agle 50 minute tak gym ke bade mirror ke saamne biceps flex karke 100 selfies aur 4 reels shoot karna!

TT ne platform par pakad liya: Ticket dikhao! 
 Yatri: Arre main train me baith kar aaya hi nahi! 
 TT: Is baat ka kya saboot hai tumhare paas? 
 Yatri: Saboot yahi hai sir ki mere paas ticket nahi hai!

Pappu: Yaar kal raat train me mujhe bilkul neend nahi aayi. Ek toh upper berth mili thi aur upar se garmi bohot thi. \n Dost: Arre toh neeche kisi se seat exchange kar leta na! \n Pappu: Kisse exchange karta bhai? Neeche wali seat par koi tha hi nahi!

Indian train journey ka niyam: Train platform chhodte hi pehle seat ke neeche lohe ki chain se suitcase lock karenge, aur theek 5 minute baad poora parivaar aloo ke parathe aur aam ka achaar khol kar khana shuru kar dega!

Cycle wale ne paidal ja rahe aadmi ko takkar maar di aur bola: 'Bhai sahab, aap bohot kismat wale ho!' \n Ghayal aadmi: 'Ek toh takkar maari aur upar se kehta hai kismat wala hoon?' \n Cycle wala: 'Haan bhai, kyu ki aaj meri truck ki chhutti thi, warna socho kya hota!'

Traffic Police: Helmet kyu nahi pehna? \n Biker: Sir bas yahan saamne wali gali me hi jaa raha tha. \n Police: Toh kya Yamraj runway se flight leke aayenge? Wo bhi yahin saamne wali gali me hi ghoom rahe hain!

Auto meter par 70 rupaye bane. 
 Auto Driver: Sahab 120 rupaye de do. 
 Passenger: Meter par toh 70 dikha raha hai! 
 Auto Driver: Sahab aate waqt wahan se khaali aana padega, uska return fare kaun dega!
Teacher: Exam ke 3 ghante me student ka dimaag sabse tez aur active kab chalta hai? \n Student: Sir jab invigilator dusri taraf muh karke zordar khansi karta hai!

Student exam hall se haste hue seeti bajate bahar aaya. \n Dost: Bhai paper kaisa gaya? \n Student: Ekdum zabardast! Pehla sawal chhoot gaya, doosra aata nahi tha, teesre me galat likh diya, baaki sab first class!
Exam hall ke aakhri 15 minute: Jo bachha poore 2 ghante se ceiling fan ko dekh raha tha, wo achanak chillata hai: 'Sir supplement sheet lao jaldi!' Aur usme Bollywood movie ki kahani pel deta hai!

Teacher: Pappu batao, India Gate kya hai? 
 Pappu: Sir, India Gate best quality ke basmati chawal hain! 
 Teacher (hairaan): Aur Charminar kya hai? 
 Pappu: Sir wo bohot mashhoor beedi ka brand hai!

Pappu dukaan par gaya: Bhaiya ek shampoo ka bottle dena. \n Dukaanwale ne bottle di. \n Pappu: Is par likha hai 'For Dry Hair'... mere baal toh abhi paani se bheege hain, koi geele baalon wala shampoo dikhao!
Doctor: Pappu, tum roz subah jogging kyu nahi karte? \n Pappu: Doctor sahab, jab pairon ko achhe se pata hai ki ghoom-fir kar wapas yahin aana hai, toh faltu me petrol kyu jalana!

Banta: Santa tu khaali pet kitne kele kha sakta hai? 
 Santa: Main 6 kele kha sakta hoon. 
 Banta: Galat! Pehla kela khane ke baad pet khaali kahan bacha! Isliye tu bas ek hi kela kha sakta hai. 
 Santa ghar gaya aur biwi se poochha: Tu khaali pet kitne kele kha sakti hai? 
 Biwi: Main 4 kha sakti hoon. 
 Santa: Dhhatt teri ki! Agar 6 bolti toh ek mast joke sunata!

Banta: Yaar Santa, petrol itna zyada mehenga ho gaya hai, desh me kitna aakrosh hai! \n Santa: Mujhe toh koi farak nahi padta bhai. Main pehle bhi 500 ka hi dalwata tha, aur aaj bhi 500 ka hi dalwata hoon!

Santa computer institute gaya. \n Teacher: Agar window band karni ho toh kone me bane red cross par click karo. \n Santa ne seedhe monitor par hathoda maar diya: 'Sir screen tod di hai, ab batao mouse kahan ghumaun?'

Question: Nadi ke beech me nimbu ka ped laga hai, nimbu kaise todoge? 
 Answer: Chidiya ban kar ud kar todunga! 
 Question: Par tumhe chidiya kaun banayega? 
 Answer: Wahi jo nadi ke beech me nimbu ka ped lagayega!

Question: Doctor aur Vakil ke peshe me kya bada antar hai? \n Answer: Vakil chahta hai aap musibat me faso aur doctor chahta hai aap beemar pado, par dono me ek badi similarity hai: Dono ki fees par 1 rupaye ka bhi discount nahi milta!
Question: Ek machhar doosre machhar se weekend par kya bolta hai? \n Answer: Chalo kisi badi wedding party me chalte hain, aaj raat sabka meetha khoon peeyenge!
Dentist Simran ka daant nikaalne ke baad muskura kar bola: 'JAW Simran JAW, jee le apni zindagi!'
Question: How do you say 'She is calling an Uber cab' in just one English word? \n Answer: 'VOCABULARY' (Vo cab bula rahi)!
Question: How do you politely request your Maasi to take a holy dip in the river? \n Answer: 'DIPLOMACY' (Dip lo Maasi)!
Question: What did one scientific calculator say to the other calculator in the morning? \n Answer: 'CASIO!' (Kaisi ho?)
Pati: Main laptop par PowerPoint presentation bana raha hoon. \n Patni: Remote ka cell down ho gaya hai, market se ek EXCEL leke aana!
Dost: Bhai sardi bohot hai, maine pichhle teen din se nahaya nahi hai! \n Me: Arre chinta mat kar bhai, 'Koi BATH nahi'!
Last night I ate super fiery spicy garlic chutney with parathas. This morning in the bathroom, I finally learnt my 'LEHSUN'!
Mera dimaag bilkul Google Search Engine ki tarah hi superfast hai, bas jab exam hall me baithta hoon tab screen par 'No Internet Connection' dikha deta hai!
Dost: Naye kapde pehne hain, sach bata main kaisa lag raha hoon? \n Me: Bilkul Bollywood ka action hero lag raha hai bhai, bas background me thoda dukh bhara music bajna chahiye!
Duniya ke gyaani log kehte hain ki 'Paisa sab kuch nahi hota'... par jab mahine ke end me wallet kholo toh pata chalta hai ki wahi sach me sab kuch hota tha!

Dad: Beta kal school kyu nahi gaya tha? \n Son: Papa teacher ne bola tha ki kal class me 'Surprise Test' hoga. Agar main school chala jaata toh becharon ka surprise kharab ho jaata na! \n Dad: Wah beta, itne nek vichaar ke liye ye flying chappal gift me le lo!

Dad sofa par baithe hue: Beta zara ek glass paani lana. 
 Beta paani laata hai. 
 Dad: Thanda nahi hai. 
 Beta fridge se laata hai. 
 Dad: Thoda normal mix kar de. 
 Beta: Papa seedhe bol do na ki aalas aa raha tha aur mujhe exercise karwani thi!
Chhote bachhe ne mandir me haath jod kar prarthana ki: 'Hey bhagwan ji, bas is baar Geography ke paper me Delhi ko Japan ki capital bana do, main answer sheet me wahi likh kar aaya hoon!'
Chintu: Mummy, main bada hokar pilot banunga aur hawa me plane udaunga! \n Mummy: Beta pehle homework khatam kar le, warna papa ke purane scooter par poora shehar ghoomna padega!
Dadi: Beta prasad me kya loge, motichoor laddoo ya kaju katli? \n Pappu: Dadi bhagwan ke ghar me bhedbhav nahi karte, dono barabar-barabar meri plate me daal do!

Padosi: Bhaisahab, ye lijiye Diwali ki shubhkaamnaayein aur ye meetha tohfa! \n Hum (dabba dekh kar man me): Arre nahi! Ye toh wahi Soan Papdi ka dabba hai jo pichhle saal maine Sharma ji ko diya tha, Sharma ji ne Verma ji ko aur Verma ji ne inko diya tha!
Diwali par Soan Papdi koi mithaai nahi hai, balki wo ek circulating football hai jise har parivaar doosre ke paale me pass karne ke liye hi khareedta hai!
Holi ka niyam: Subah aisi t-shirt pehno jise pichhle 5 saal se pocha banane ki koshish ki ja rahi ho, taaki rang lagne ke baad fenkte waqt aatma ko shanti mile!
Gully cricket ka samvidhanik niyam: Jis ladke ka bat hoga, pehli batting usi ki hogi... chahe pehli ball par clean bowled ho jaye, wo use trial ball bol kar dobara khelega!
Bowler: Bhai catch le liya, tu out hai! \n Batsman: Arre pagal ho gaya hai kya? Gully ke rule ke hisaab se agar ball naali me girne ke baad pakdi jaye toh wo 'Dead Ball' hoti hai, out nahi!
Gully cricket me sabse bada khauf bowling ya bouncer ka nahi hota... balki us saamne wale ghar ki aunty ka hota hai jinke terrace par ball jaate hi ball zapt ho jaati hai!

Gabbar: Arre o Kalia, kitne aadmi the? 
 Kalia: Sarkar, poore do aadmi the! 
 Gabbar: Toh khaali haath kyu laut aaye? 
 Kalia: Wo sarkaar, aapke dialogue maarte-maarte dono hero bike start karke nikal gaye!

Basanti: Bhaag Dhanno bhaag, aaj teri Basanti ki izzat ka sawal hai! \n Dhanno (ghodi): Arre Basanti, izzat toh teri bach jayegi, par pichhle 5 kilometer se daud-daud kar meri tangon me fracture ho jayega!
Gabbar: Ye haath mujhe de de Thakur! \n Thakur: Le le bhai bina dare le le, par pehle ye bata ki jab bartan dhone ki baari aayegi toh kaun dhoega!

Daily morning routine: Subah 6:00 baje alarm baje toh Snooze kiya, 6:15 par Snooze, 6:30 par Snooze... achanak aankh khuli toh 8:45 baj chuke the aur baaki ka routine 100 meter Olympic sprint ban gaya!
Ghar ka darwaza lock karte waqt ki pavitra prathmikta: Phone, Wallet, aur Chabi... agar inme se ek bhi jeb me na mile toh darwaze se wapas bhaagna hi param shanti hai!
Barber baal kaatne ke baad mirror dikhata hai: 'Bhaiya theek hai na?' \n Chahe usne baalon ka pineapple bana diya ho, dil se bas ek hi jhooth nikalta hai: 'Haan bhaiya, ekdum perfect!'

Desi restaurant rule: Restaurant me baith kar 10 minute tak Chinese, Continental aur Italian ka poora menu padhenge... aur ant me waiter aate hi bolenge: 'Bhaiya ek Paneer Butter Masala aur 3 Butter Naan le aao!'

Photographer 6 saal ke Chintu se bola: Beta camera ki taraf dekho, abhi isme se kabootar niklega! \n Chintu: Bewakoofon jaisi baatein mat kar uncle, lighting dekh, portrait mode laga, ISO 200 par rakh aur 4K me click kar!
Mummy: Aaj school ke tiffin me lauki ki sabzi di thi, kha kar kyu nahi aaya? \n Chintu: Mummy maine bohot koshish ki, par lauki tiffin box se bahar aane ke liye taiyyar hi nahi hui!

Papa: Beta tera report card kahan hai? 
 Chintu: Papa wo maine dost ko kiraye par de diya hai. 
 Papa: Kiraye par kyu? 
 Chintu: Uska report card achha aa gaya tha, aur aaj uska papa se maar khane ka mood ho raha tha!
Adult life ka sach: 30 ki umra paar karte hi shareer ke joints weather forecast center ban jaate hain... barish shuru hone se aadha ghanta pehle hi kamar aur ghutna bol padta hai!
30 saal ke home loan lene ke baad insaan jitni wafadaari aur obedience bank manager ko dikhata hai, utni toh pet dog bhi apne maalik ko nahi dikhata!
Doctor: Aapki age kya hai? \n Patient: Doctor sahab, Aadhar Card par 31 likha hai, par subah so kar uthte waqt feel bilkul 70 saal ke pensioner jaisa hota hai!
Golgappe wale bhaiya se paani-puri khatam hone ke baad hath aage karke 'Bhaiya ek extra sukhi papdi dena masala daal ke' maangna har bhartiya ka samvidhanik adhikar hai!
Chai ki tapri par 10 rupaye ki cutting chai haath me lekar do desi dost poori duniya ki geopolitics, Indian cricket team selection aur share market ka mustaqbil 7 minute me decide kar dete hain!

Patni neend se uthte hi romantic hokar boli: Sunte ho ji? Mujhe abhi sapna aaya ki aap mere liye heeron ka chamchamata haar leke aaye ho! \n Pati: Theek hai, toh jaldi se wapas so jao aur pehan kar ghoomo!
Pati (gusse me shaq karte hue): Tune meri chai me taweez kyu daal rakha hai? Mujhe vash me karne ke liye? \n Patni: Pagal ho gaye ho kya, ye taweez nahi, Green Tea ka Tea-Bag hai!

Patni: Tum har ladai me mere maayke walo ko beech me kyu kheench laate ho? \n Pati: Dekho, jab TV me koi technical kharab aati hai toh TV ko thodi dosh dete hain, gaali toh company walo ko hi padti hai!

Pati badam kha raha tha. 
 Biwi: Suno na, mujhe bhi taste karao! 
 Pati ne jeb se ek badam nikaal kar biwi ko de diya. 
 Biwi: Bas ek hi badam doge? 
 Pati: Haan, kyu ki baaki sabka bhi taste bilkul aisa hi hai!

Pati: Yaar bohot pyaas lagi hai, ek glass paani le aao. 
 Patni: Kyu na aaj main tumhare liye matar paneer aur shahi pulao banau? 
 Pati: Waah! Muh me paani aa gaya! 
 Patni: Bas aa gaya na paani? Usi se kaam chala lo!
Teacher: Pappu batao, chipkali kise kehte hain? \n Pappu: Chipkali ek bohot gareeb magarmachh hai sir, jise bachpan me Bournvita wala doodh nahi mila, isliye bechari kuposhan ka shikar ho gayi!

Teacher: Kal main class me sooraj (sun) par lecture dene jaa rahi hoon, koi class miss mat karna. 
 Pappu: Madam main nahi aa paunga. 
 Teacher: Kyu? 
 Pappu: Wo kya hai na madam, meri mummy mujhe itni dhoop me itni door jaane hi nahi dengi!
Teacher: Hindi me Ghazal aur Bhashan me kya antar hai? \n Pappu: Sir, parayi aurat ka har shabd ghazal lagta hai aur apni biwi ka har shabd bhashan!

Doctor: Jab tum depression aur stress me hote ho, toh kya karte ho? 
 Mareez: Ji main mandir chala jaata hoon. 
 Doctor: Waah, wahan jaakar dhyaan aur dhyan-lagate ho? 
 Mareez: Ji nahi, mandir ke baahar sab logo ke joote-chappal aapas me mix kar deta hoon... phir un logo ko gusse me pareshaan dekh kar mera stress chhoo-mantar ho jaata hai!
Doctor marne ke baad upar swarg pahuncha, wahan use apna purana mareez mil gaya. \n Mareez: Doctor sahab, ab toh hum dono mar chuke hain, ab toh sach bata do... aakhir mujhe beemari kya thi?!

Pappu: Doctor sahab, koi badhiya dawaai dijiye, bohot zordar sar dard ho raha hai! \n Doctor: Is waqt aapko aaraam aur shaanti ki sabse zyada zaroorat hai. Main neend ki goliya likh raha hoon, roz raat ko apni biwi ko doodh me mila kar pila dena!

Santa clinic gaya: Doctor sahab, ghar aakar patient check karne ki kya fees hai? 
 Doctor: 300 rupaye. 
 Santa: Theek hai chaliye. 
 Doctor apni gaadi se Santa ke ghar pahuncha aur poochha: Mareez kahan hai? 
 Santa: Arre koi mareez nahi hai doctor sahab, taxi wala 500 maang raha tha aur aap 300 me chhod aaye!

Santa: Mujhe apni biwi se talak chahiye, wo roz bartan phenk kar maarti hai. \n Banta: Ye toh pichhle 3 saal se phenk rahi hai, ab achanak talak kyu? \n Santa: Kyu ki ab uska nishana pakka ho gaya hai!

Banta ko phoot-phoot kar rota dekh Santa ne poochha: Tu itna kyu ro raha hai bhai, kya padosi ke haathi se bohot pyaar karta tha? \n Banta: Pyaar nahi karta tha bhai, mujhe uski qabr khodne ka theka mila hai!
Professor: Semester system se students ko kya asar padta hai? \n Student: Fayda toh pata nahi sir, par saal me ek ki jagah do baar beizzati jhelne ki aadat pad jaati hai!

External Viva Examiner: Newton ka teesra niyam (Third Law) kya hai? 
 Student: Sir shuruat ki lines toh bhool gaya, bas aakhri line pakki yaad hai. 
 Examiner: Chalo aakhri line hi suna do! 
 Student: '...aur isi ko Newton ka teesra niyam kehte hain!'

Teacher: Sanju batao, 'Itihaas' (History) kise kehte hain? \n Sanju: Sir jab purane jamane ke log kand karke mar jaate hain aur unki galtiyon ki saza exam me hume yaad karke bhugtani padti hai, use itihaas kehte hain!
Teacher: Pedon aur jungle ki katai rokne ka koi solid upay batao. \n Student: Sir saare school aur college exams cancel kar do, hazaro ton paper bachega aur jungle bach jayenge!

Employee: Sir, mujhe turant 30% salary hike chahiye, kyu ki aaj kal do bohot badi companiyan mere peeche lagi hui hain! \n Boss (hairaan hokar): Kaun si companiyan? \n Employee: Ek bijli ke bill wali aur doosri paani ke bill wali!

Employee: HR ma'am, meri salary thodi aur badha dijiye. \n HR: Par pichhle mahine hi toh tumhe hike mili thi! \n Employee: Ma'am wo hike toh maine us nayi car ki EMI bharne ke liye li thi jo maine pichhli hike milne ki khushi me khareed li thi!

Corporate office meeting ka ajeeb dukh: 1 ghante ki meeting me sirf 5 minute kaam ki baat hoti hai, aur baaki 55 minute ye decide karne me nikal jaate hain ki agali meeting kab aur kis time par rakhni hai!
Bhai (Raksha Bandhan par baithkar): Behna ab aarti utar kar rakhi baandh bhi de! \n Behen: Kalai peeche karo bhaiya, pehle 5000 rupaye GPay karo, screenshot verified dekhne ke baad hi dori bandhegi!

Bhai: Tu itni der se kamre ka darwaza band karke kisse ghanto baat kar rahi hai? \n Behen: Jisse bhi karu, tujhe kya matlab? \n Bhai: Achha theek hai, toh agle mahine ka Wi-Fi recharge bhi usi se karwa lena, main password badal raha hoon!

Ladka: Bhai aaj poori himmat juta kar college me crush ko rose dekar propose kiya tha! \n Dost: Phir kya hua bhai? \n Ladka: Us chudail ne bag se rakhi nikaal kar meri kalai par baandh di aur boli 'I love you mere pyare bhaiya'!

Desi middle class kitchen ki parampara: Har ghar me ek aisi 'Mahabali Plastic Thaili' hoti hai jiske pet ke andar pichhle 5 saalon ki 200 aur thailiyan thhuns kar rakhi hoti hain, taaki aane wali agali teen peedhiyon ko kabhi polythene ki kami na ho!
Zindagi me ek desi insaan ko sabse gehra dukh tab hota hai, jab garam chai me duboya hua Parle-G biscuit muh tak pahunchne se theek ek second pehle pyali ke andar toot kar shaheed ho jata hai!

Gully cricket ka niyam no. 7: Agar batsman ke zordar shot se ball saamne wali naali me chali gayi, toh batsman out nahi hoga... par naali me ghus kar ball nikaalne aur use paani se dhone ki saza usi batsman ki hogi!
source_name: Times of India & Gully Cricket Chronicles

content: Gully cricket boundary rule: Deewar ko direct ball lagi toh six run... par agar ball deewar taap kar padosi Sharma ji ke veranda me giri toh batsman out, aur Sharma ji se daant kha kar ball wapas laane ka risk bhi usi ka!
source_name: Times of India & Gully Cricket Chronicles

content: char: kal main sooraj par laikchar dene jaa rahi hoon, tum log class mis mat karana. Pappu: lekin main nahi aa paoonga Madam.. Teacher: kyoon Pappu: woh kya hai ki meri Mummy mujhe itani door nahi jane dengi. 🤣

beemar Pappu ko dekhane uski Teacher uske ghar aaeen. Teacher ne dekha ki monu bistar par sir ke bal khada huaa hai . Teacher: mainne suna tha ki tum beemar ho par tum toh sheershasan kar rahe ho! Pappu: maim beemar hi hoon. abhi siradard kee goli khaayi hai, kaheen galati se pet mein na chali jae, isalie sir ke bal khada hoon! 🤣
Teacher gusse mein: Pappu yahan main padha rahi hoon aur tum bate kar rahe ho? Pappu, Teacher se: yahan hum baten kar rahe hain aur aap humein padhane mein lagi hain! 🤣

Student paper de raha tha, paper mein pucha gaya ki — anuvad karen angreji mein –“santosh aam khata hai !” Student: Ek Student ne anuvad kiya , jise padhakar aapki hi nahi angreji kee bhi aatma kanp gayi satisfaction is a general account!! 🤣
Teacher: apane Papa ka nam angreji mein bolo? stoodent: byootiphul red andaraviyar! Teacher: kya bakavas hai hindi mein batao? stoodent: sundar lal chaddha…🤣
Teacher: batao tumhar homavark kahan hai… Pappu: Madam Facebook par chek karie, mainne skreenashot apalod kar diye hain aur aapko taig bhi kar diya hai. 🤣
Ek Master ji ne Student se pucha – Master ji: gajal aur bhashan mein kya antar hai ? Student: paraayi aurat ka har shabd gajal hai auraapani beebi ka har shabd bhashan !! 🤣

Teacher: Sanju, batao “itihas” kise kahate hain? Sanju: Sir, jab purane jamane ke log kand karake mar jaate the aur humein ab unhe yad karna padata hai, usi ko itihas kahate hain. Teacher: chup kar! gadhe kaheen ke. 🤣
Teacher: kaun si jati ke log acche nagarik hote hain ? Student: banie ! Teacher: woh kaise ? Student: kyonki Sir har jagah likha hota hai desh ke acche nagarik “banie “. 🤣
Teacher: Pappu, chalo ab mujhe votar ka phormoola batao… Pappu: HIJKLMNO Teacher: gadhe! yeh kya bakavas hai… Pappu: aapane hi toh votar ka phormoola H to O bataya tha. 🤣
Master ji: sabase zyada nasha kisamen hota hai? Student: kitab mein Master ji: kaise? Student: kyonki kitab kholate hi neend aa jaati hai 🤣

Teacher: golu tum kaayi dinon se school nahi aa rahe the kahan the ? golu: bard phlu ho gaya tha Teacher: tumhe bard phlu yeh toh bard ko hota hai… golu: aapane mujhe insan samajha hi kahan roz toh murga banate ho !!! 🤣

Teacher: dekho beta,juaa nahi khelate. yeh aisi aadat hai ki yadi isamen aaj jeetoge toh kal haroge, parso jeetoge toh usse agale din har jaoge. bigadail stoodent: bus, Madam! main samajh gaya, aage se main Ek din chhodakar khela karoonga. 🤣

teetu: Sir, log hindi ya inglish mein hi kyu bolate hain. maiths mein kyu nahi? Teacher: zyada 3 -5 mat karo , 9 -2 -11 ho jao , nahi toh 5 -7 kheench kar doonga toh 6 ke 36 najar aaenge aur 32 ke 32 bahar nikal aaenge. teetu: bus sara…samajh gaya, hindi inglish hi theek hai ,maiths kee bhasha toh badi khauphanak hai. 🤣

Teacher: tum padhane mein dhyan kyu nahi dete ho ? teetu: kyonki padhaayi sirph Do vajah se kee jaati hai. pahala karan hai dar aur doosara karan shauk bina vajah ke shauk hum palate nahi aur darate toh hum kisi ke Baap se nahi 🤣
